ski: Rain at most Washington and Oregon resorts today, with under 1 in of new snow through Thursday. Snow returns to the Washington Cascades Friday, then Saturday dries out.
hike: The mountains stay mostly clear through Thursday, with light snow on the highest terrain today. Driest Thursday is at Methow & Sawtooth, dry under clear skies, with a high of 31 and gusts to 11 mph, NWAC has no rating posted.
